name: Input + Interactive Program — Cyber Terminal & Bot
description: Lesson 18 — Master Python input() and interactive programs: chat with your AI Bot, follow starter commands, and insert your own interactive prompts, choices, and inputs.

labels.login: authenticates cadet user on the Cyber Terminal
labels.say: AI Bot synthesizes voice and displays holographic speech
labels.patrol: activates hover thrusters to scan and patrol the sector
labels.boost: engages overdrive turbo boost with neon particle trail
labels.celebrate: triggers festive victory light show and robotic cheer
labels.print: outputs telemetry text to terminal console

legend: 💬 name = input("Enter name: ") prompt user · print("Hi", name) display response · if cmd == "boost": interactive branch · int(input()) convert to number
idleText: Cyber Bot A.E.X.-18 is online on the command deck. Write interactive Python programs to chat, decide actions, and calibrate shields!
userIdea: Input + Interactive Program: students experience how to use python Input and Interactive Programs from following the command to inserting their own prompts, choices, and inputs, with smooth interactive graphics and visual condition/variable understanding
